title: THE HIT MARKER IS THE INSIDE OF THE CROSSHAIR
why: His order of 2026-10-12 on hit markers in 2.5D: maybe just on the inside of the crosshair. A round of yours that lands now flashes the centre of your crosshair: the dot swells into a small diamond and a thin ring pulses out to the arms, white for a hit, orange for a weak spot, and bigger and red for a kill, for about a sixth of a second, with the tick you already hear. The four faint diagonal ticks are gone; the arms and the ammo and reload rings are unchanged. Player 2 sees his own markers in his own window, now with his kills, which his window never marked before. A weak spot hit also lost its mark to the plain one, so it never showed or sounded as a weak spot; it does now. A round that lands on an animal marks a hit too.
now: A landed round flashes the centre of your crosshair: white for a hit, orange for a weak spot, bigger and red for a kill.
